panels.description: Share of endpoints the agents' health checks see healthy (flock_agent_backendctl).

targets.expr: (100 * sum by(backend_uuid)(flock_agent_backendctl_endpoint_state{instance_uuid="$instance_uuid",agent_host=~"$agent_host",backend_uuid=~"$backend_uuid"}) / count by(backend_uuid)(flock_agent_backendctl_endpoint_state{instance_uuid="$instance_uuid",agent_host=~"$agent_host",backend_uuid=~"$backend_uuid"})) * on(backend_uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(max by(uuid, name)(flock_controller_store_info{type_url="type.googleapis.com/flock.api.config.backend.v1.Backend"}), "backend_uuid", "$1", "uuid", "(.*)")

targets.expr: sum by(agent_name)(node_ipvs_backend_connections_active{instance_uuid="$instance_uuid",agent_host=~"$agent_host"} * on(agent_uuid, local_address) group_left() label_replace(max by(agent_uuid, ip)(flock_agent_announce_vips{instance_uuid="$instance_uuid",uuid="$vip_uuid"}), "local_address", "$1", "ip", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Active Connections on IPVS for VIP $vip_name
panels.description: Needs node_exporter as a proxy target of the agents (metrics.proxy.targets), with its ipvs collector (on by default on linux) running in the host network namespace.

targets.expr: sum by(agent_name)(node_ipvs_backend_connections_inactive{instance_uuid="$instance_uuid",agent_host=~"$agent_host"} * on(agent_uuid, local_address) group_left() label_replace(max by(agent_uuid, ip)(flock_agent_announce_vips{instance_uuid="$instance_uuid",uuid="$vip_uuid"}), "local_address", "$1", "ip", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Inactive Connections on IPVS for VIP $vip_name
